description: Every act that a client can show around the face of an agent while it works. A stage and a tool name acts by key in their `acts`.

acts.title: Writing
acts.description: A pen writes a few lines of text that rise and fade.

acts.title: Reading
acts.description: A page of text scrolls upward while the eyes follow its lines.

acts.title: Searching
acts.description: A magnifying glass turns and grows and shrinks over a few results.

acts.title: Analyzing
acts.description: Vertical bars rise and fall beside a line that traces them.

acts.title: Asking
acts.description: Question marks appear above the face one after another.

acts.title: Coding
acts.description: Brackets and a cursor blink beside the face.

acts.title: Calculating
acts.description: Numbers and signs flip in turn beside the face.

acts.title: Planning
acts.description: A checklist is ticked item by item.

acts.title: Fetching
acts.description: Documents drop toward the face from above.

acts.title: Reviewing
acts.description: A check mark is drawn over a page, then the page is set aside.

acts.title: Comparing
acts.description: Two pages swing side by side, with a mark where they differ.

acts.title: Saving
acts.description: A page folds into a box that closes.

acts.title: Typing
acts.description: A cursor blinks and keys tap while letters appear in a line beside the face.

acts.title: Interviewing
acts.description: Speech bubbles of two sizes take turns beside the face, one answering the other.

acts.title: Summarizing
acts.description: Several lines are drawn together into one short line.

acts.title: Linking
acts.description: A line is drawn from one dot to another, and the dots light up.

acts.title: Exporting
acts.description: A page slides out of a tray toward the edge.
